name: Days of Memories  ~Koi wa Good Job!~
original_name: Days of Memories 〜恋はグッジョブ!〜
source:
Main character's hobby is taking photos, so he is happy to get a job at a professional photographer office, but the ends up just carrying apparatus and making unexciting photos for local news. This summer he wants to take such a photo to astonish everyone. A lot of different girls surround protagonist. What kind of summer will it be?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的爱好是拍照，所以他很高兴在专业摄影师办公室找到一份工作，但最终只是携带设备，为当地新闻拍摄平淡无奇的照片。今年夏天他想拍这样一张照片让大家惊叹不已。主角周围有很多不同的女孩。这将会是一个怎样的夏天呢？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
